source_policy: QREF-63791-006 provides17level/WeiDabao/15firewood/30000silver/once; IREF-39807-019-4provides material name only. Gathering objects,position,timing,ownership and permissions below are local design,not published monster/drop claims.

quest.name: 寻找木柴
quest.readiness: derived from carried bound firewood>=15; not independently saved count,warehouse never counted
quest.acceptance: alive,out of combat,idle,no challenge,valid level and class/route,NPC2.5m; never already delivered
quest.repeat: once per character across worlds; completion is character quest identity,not world/day reset
quest.abandon: confirmation removes only this quest bound firewood from all carried ownership,keeps unrelated materials; resets active progress,no fee/refund; delivered cannot abandon/reaccept
quest.delivery: same qualification and NPC; atomically consume15 bound carried firewood,credit30000silver,mark delivered and unique receipt; silver ceiling failure leaves entire input and state unchanged
quest.modifiers: task silver excluded from shop-price,team,finisher,training modifiers; no automatic supreme multiplier
quest.replay: character/quest/final-settlement unique; request_id and expected_revision; stale/retry returns original or rejects,never regrants
quest.save: 05/19host settlement with character-only completion; no unrecorded gather progress or reset on room load

item.name: 木柴
item.identity_policy: not LinglongBamboo or general timber,never converts old bamboo/materials by name

gather.qualification: alive,out of combat,idle,no challenge,own quest accepted and not delivered,own carried amount<15; within2m and unobstructed LOS
gather.tool: intrinsic hand-gather animation for14classes,not weapon attack or consumed axe
gather.cancellation: movement/dodge/attack/skill/new interaction/hostile damage/invalid pile or range cancels without materials or recharge; damage adjudicated before completion same step
gather.output: 1physical quest_firewood,100%,no bonus quantities/randomness/XP; no virtual count; recheck final backpack slot/weight and max15 at completion
gather.capacity_failure: reject whole gather,no material/no pile cooldown; no warehouse/ground overflow
gather.ownership: shared pile,cannot have two active collectors; host reserves by actual accepted action,conflict rejects; after successful gather one1800step cooldown shared per pile
gather.blocked_or_empty: no action accepted during regrowth; no node switching or nearest pile substitution
gather.node_reset: generation/recharge/reservation belongs world,not visiting character; map enter/exit never resets
gather.completion: same host transaction creates physical item,advances pile generation,starts recharge and issues receipt; client retry no duplicate output
gather.save: world.firewood_piles stores4known IDs,last generation,remaining recharge0..1800,and accepted collector/action reservation or null;05fixed-step snapshot saves action remaining/target; no duplicate inventory quantity cache
gather.offline_pause: freeze remaining recharge/action with whole world;LAN host continues,disconnect cancels reservation/no output
gather.load: missing/bad new fields reject; restore same cooldown/action,never fresh pile or free gathered unit

initialization.explicit_new_world: initialize four pile records to declared generation0/recharge0/reservation null; not initial material grant
initialization.explicit_new_role: not_accepted with no quest wood or completion receipt
initialization.known_legacy: no source firewood quest; explicitly not_accepted,no material,retain all unrelated old story progress
initialization.existing_world_content_change: explicit marked content initialization needed,never infer missing fields on load
